resilience.rationale: Malformed, duplicate, hostile, oversized, secret-bearing, unsupported-version, subscription-mismatched, missing, expired, MFA, cancelled, offline, and denied cases fail closed or remain explicitly non-ready.

visual_quality.rationale: No product pixels are added; exact product hierarchy, responsive layout, focus, and visual review remain an external integration gate.

windows.rationale: Focused tests, app registration, and warning-denied Clippy passed locally on Windows x86_64 without running Azure tools, WAM, or network.

linux.rationale: The pure contract is platform-neutral, but this M9 run did not execute natively on Linux.

macos.rationale: The pure contract is platform-neutral, but this M9 run did not execute natively on macOS.

features.title: Nonactivated bounded Kubernetes and OpenShift source contracts

accessibility.rationale: M11 adds no active renderer or control; product UI and controlled native screen-reader evidence remain external.

correctness.rationale: Thirteen focused contracts and two app guards cover stable exact and private-transient sources, typed YAML/JSON, merge/reference behavior, capsule pinning, exact isolated kubectl/oc plans, explicit failures, and independent disabled registration.

security.rationale: Links/reparse points, source drift, oversized/hostile/ambiguous documents, external credential paths, proxy routes, insecure production TLS, auth-provider blocks, secret-bearing exec flags, cross-session grants, and shared context/project mutation fail closed; secret values are discarded.

performance.rationale: The 50-sample optimized 900 KiB Windows target measured 1.8280-1.8788 ms with eight high-side outliers. Parsing is explicit-only, bounded, and absent from startup/input/render/resize/PTY paths; controlled baselines remain external.

resource_lifetime.rationale: Stable reads close their file handle on return and plans own no worker, child, socket, browser, listener, PTY, route, cache, credential, or GPU resource; all future processes require whole-tree cancellation and remain nonactivated.

storage_hygiene.rationale: The adapter reads only an exact granted regular file or caller-supplied private transient bytes, persists nothing, never edits user kubeconfig, and retains public metadata plus opaque references only. Private allocation, permissions, cleanup, and uninstall fixtures remain external.

resilience.rationale: Malformed YAML/JSON, limits, source changes, missing references, collisions, denied/failed plugins, missing tools, expiry, MFA, cancellation, offline, access denial, unsupported versions, and generic errors are deterministic and non-ready.

visual_quality.rationale: No product pixels are added; hierarchy, responsive layout, focus, and visual review remain an external integration gate.

windows.rationale: Focused tests, native regular-file checks, app registration, warning-denied Clippy, dependency policy, and benchmark ran locally on Windows x86_64 without kubectl, oc, plugin, cluster, browser, or network.

linux.rationale: Unix no-follow and symlink tests compile, but this M11 run did not execute natively on Linux.

features.title: Nonactivated bounded Teleport organization-identity source contracts

accessibility.rationale: M12 adds no active renderer or control; product UI and controlled native screen-reader evidence remain external.

correctness.rationale: Eleven focused contracts and one app guard cover bounded public status, expiry, exact version/login/status/ssh/logout plans, capsule revalidation, explicit failures, and independent disabled registration.

security.rationale: Sensitive/ambient/hostile/expired input, proxy or capsule drift, agent addition, inherited Teleport environment, surprise relogin, and automatic access requests fail closed; the adapter never reads tsh cache, certificate, token, identity, or agent material.

performance.rationale: A longer 100-sample Windows run measured 18.359-18.945 microseconds and found no statistically significant change (p=0.82) after a noisy 50-sample regression signal; controlled named-hardware baselines remain external.

resource_lifetime.rationale: Pure plans own no worker, process, socket, browser, listener, file, certificate, cache, agent, PTY, route, or GPU resource; every future operation is bounded, cancellable as a process tree, and nonactivated.

storage_hygiene.rationale: The adapter performs no filesystem I/O or persistence, never reads or writes ~/.tsh, and retains only bounded public status plus opaque references.

resilience.rationale: Malformed, over-complex, sensitive-schema-drifted, mismatched, expired, revoked, MFA-required, cancelled, offline, denied, unsupported-version, and generic-error cases are deterministic and non-ready; benign unretained fields are discarded and disable/uninstall affects only Automexia registration.

visual_quality.rationale: No product pixels are added; hierarchy, responsive layout, focus, and visual review remain an external integration gate.

windows.rationale: Focused tests, app registration, warning-denied Clippy, dependency policy, and benchmark ran locally on Windows x86_64 without tsh, proxy, browser, agent, PTY, or network.

linux.rationale: The pure contract is platform-neutral, but this M12 run did not execute natively on Linux.
